A '''laboratory''' owned by [[Celestial Industries]] was located in the [[Advanced Product Research Sector]] of the [[Labor Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="LOC" /> During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] set up [[Danison Varik]] in the lab where he designed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for them; however, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces managed to breach the lab and capture Varik.<ref name="TOR" />
